import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('products/services/catalogue-inbound-cad')
packet_bytes = (root / 'operator-reply-packet.json').read_bytes()
rehearsal_bytes = (root / 'decision-table-rehearsal.json').read_bytes()
packet = json.loads(packet_bytes)
rehearsal = json.loads(rehearsal_bytes)
rehearsal_hash = hashlib.sha256(rehearsal_bytes).hexdigest()
checks = rehearsal['checks']
replies = packet['replies']
assert packet['rehearsal_sha256'] == rehearsal_hash
assert len(checks) == packet['fictional_checks_passed'] == 5
assert all(result['passed'] and result['actual'] == result['expected'] for result in checks)
assert set(replies) == {'diagnostic', 'commission'}
for intent, reply in replies.items():
    assert reply == rehearsal['operator_reply_drafts'][intent], intent
    assert reply.startswith('EN\n') and '\nFR\n' in reply, intent
    assert 'Autonomous AI agents' in reply and 'IA autonomes' in reply, intent
assert 'eligible inquiry' in packet['evidence_stages']
assert set(packet['evidence_stages']) == {'eligible inquiry', 'recipient delivery', 'administrative order acceptance', 'deposit attestation', 'Treasury posting'}
result = {'packet_sha256': hashlib.sha256(packet_bytes).hexdigest(), 'rehearsal_sha256': rehearsal_hash, 'fixture_checks_passed': len(checks), 'verified_reply_branches': sorted(replies), 'scope': 'Offline verification of fictional decisions and exact reply text. Real case outcomes were unobserved.'}
output = json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n'
(root / 'operator-packet-readback.json').write_text(output, encoding='utf-8')
print(output)
